title: CardiCat: a Variational Autoencoder for High-Cardinality Tabular Data
summary: CardiCat is a variational autoencoder model that fits imbalanced, high-cardinality, heterogeneous tabular data by replacing one-hot encoding with jointly learned embedding layers. Its evaluation notebook imports SDV's CTGAN and TVAE synthesizers as benchmark baselines and uses sdmetrics' QualityReport to score synthetic data quality.
